description: Rehire one worker from an ended contract as a NEW ADMIN_BALANCE-funded contract with an ACTIVE_FUNDED qualification milestone. Preserves the ended contract and historical proposal. Zero money moves during rehire; later release remains human-only. Reuses the canonical Job Messages conversation and converges current new-hire Project To-dos/integrations. Fails closed on active contracts, stale lineage, unresolved funded milestones or payouts, cross-tenant targets, or missing canonical-admin authority. Same request-bound and generation-scoped idempotency as the REST operation. Besides the legacy `provisioning` fields, the response carries a live `onboarding` receipt for the NEW contract (exact assignment readback, durable hook state, provider provisioning state; recomputed on every replay): `onboarding.status` COMPLETE is the only full success — PENDING, RETRYABLE_FAILED, or terminal FAILED is a PARTIAL SUCCESS: for PENDING/RETRYABLE_FAILED retry this tool with the SAME idempotencyKey to re-heal and re-check; for FAILED (error.retryable=false) follow error.remediation instead (a same-key retry cannot heal it); read opentrain_list_project_todos for the new contract when you need current assignment truth.

idempotencyKey.description: Request-bound idempotency key (1-128 chars of letters, digits, dot, underscore, dash, colon). The same key with the same payload converges on the original result; reusing a key with a changed payload conflicts.

priorContractId.description: Ended OpenTrain contract id to chain the new contract from.

name: opentrain_create_admin_balance_rehire
